items.stem: How did Mario feel when he first saw the invisible chair? Why do you think he felt this way?
items.answer: Mario felt excited when he first saw the invisible chair. This is because he was curious about something new and different. He probably thought it was a magical object and wanted to know more about it.

items.stem: Why was it important for Mario's friends to believe in him? How did their belief help him succeed?
items.answer: Mario's friends' belief in him was very important because it gave him courage. When people believe in you, it makes you feel like you can do anything. Their belief helped him to keep on trying to sit on the invisible chair even when it seemed impossible.

items.section_heading: Answer The Following Questions In Short.
items.stem: Mario, in the story 'The Chair' experiences some challenges as he tries to sit on the invisible chair. Based on your understanding of the story, describe the challenges Mario faces and explain how he overcomes them.
items.answer: Mario faces several challenges while trying to sit on the invisible chair. First, he had to overcome his own disbelief. The concept of an invisible chair seems impossible, and Mario initially struggled to believe if it was real. Second, Mario faced the challenge of actually sitting on something he can't see. This required him to rely on his touch and balance, as well as his trust in his grandfather's words. Finally, Mario had to ignore the reactions of his friends who were making fun of him. At first, they didn't believe him about the invisible chair, which could have been discouraging.

items.section_heading: Answer The Following Questions In Short.
items.stem: However, at the end, Mario overcomes these challenges with his determination to sit on the chair and his friend's support. Do you think the story would have been different if Mario hadn't had friends to help him? Explain your answer.
items.answer: The story might have been different if Mario hadn't had friends to help him. He might have given up trying to sit on the invisible chair because it would have been too difficult on his own .His friends' support and encouragement helped him to succeed, so it's likely that the story would have had a different ending without them.

items.section_heading: Answer The Following Questions In Short.
items.stem: Imagine you were one of Mario's friends. How would you feel if you saw Mario trying to sit on something invisible? What would you do to help him?
items.answer: If I were one of Mario's friends, I would be surprised and confused to see him trying to sit on something invisible. But I would also be curious. I would want to know what he was doing. To help him, I would try to understand what he was seeing or feeling. I might ask him questions or offer to help him in some way.
